description: Welcome to this extensively upgraded 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offering approximately 1,830 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space on a generous lot with a private pool. Fully remodeled with modern finishes and quality craftsmanship throughout, this home seamlessly blends comfort, style, and functionality for today’s lifestyle. The chef’s kitchen is a true centerpiece, featuring durable plywood cabinetry with soft-close doors and drawers, sleek quartz countertops, and a full suite of premium stainless steel appliances, including a 36” Cosmo Haven Collection 6-burner gas range, matching 500 CFM hood, smart dishwasher with stainless steel tub, and a Newair dual-zone beverage fridge. Both the kitchen and bar are equipped with stainless steel undermount workstation sinks with integrated accessories for added convenience. Extensive system upgrades provide peace of mind, including a new 200-amp Siemens electrical panel with surge protection, complete electrical rewire, new water supply lines, and upgraded ABS drain lines. Additional improvements include a new asphalt shingle roof, all-new insulation, black-framed windows throughout, and a Rheem ProTerra high-efficiency hybrid heat pump water heater with leak detection and auto shutoff. The home is also EV charger ready with 50-amp capability. Interior features include waterproof vinyl flooring, porcelain tile bathrooms, 5½-inch baseboards, new interior doors and hardware, LED lighting throughout, and fresh interior and exterior paint. A Google Nest smart thermostat enhances comfort, while an expansive 8-foot bifold door creates seamless indoor-outdoor living. The spacious primary suite offers an oversized walk-in closet with an illuminated shoe rack, dual vanities, and a spa-inspired bath featuring a rainfall and handheld shower, LED-lit niche, and Bluetooth-enabled exhaust system. The backyard is designed for entertaining, complete with a sparkling pool featuring smart color-changing lighting, a new pool pump timer, updated backwash system, and new filter grids. The front yard is newly landscaped with automatic irrigation for added convenience. Ideally located just minutes from Ventura Boulevard, offering premier shopping, dining, and entertainment, along with easy access to major commuter routes. This turnkey home delivers the perfect combination of modern upgrades, luxury finishes, and everyday livability.
